description: This file defines a template function for generating customized email or message content based on event and response data, including functions for transforming responses and formatting variables.

methods.name: transformBookingResponsesToVariableFormat
methods.description: Transforms booking responses into a standardized variable format.

methods.name: transformRoutingFormResponsesToVariableFormat
methods.description: Transforms routing form responses into a standardized variable format.

methods.name: formatIdentifierToVariable
methods.description: Converts a string key into a variable format with underscores and uppercase.

methods.name: formatIdentifierToVariableLegacy
methods.description: Legacy version of formatIdentifierToVariable, strips underscores for backward compatibility.

methods.name: getVariableFormats
methods.description: Returns both current and legacy variable formats for a given key.

methods.name: replaceVariablePlaceholders
methods.description: Replaces placeholders like {VARIABLE}_VARIABLE with {VARIABLE} in text.

methods.name: customTemplate
methods.description: Generates a customized message body with variable replacements, including date formatting and response integration.
